title: The Neighborhood: asset provenance record
summary: Every picture, model and texture the game ships is either the owner's own art (Mara, one reference image) or original procedural geometry and runtime-drawn canvas textures written for this project. No downloaded, purchased, Meshy-generated or other third-party art is used. The only third-party code is the Babylon.js engine, vendored locally.
